reuse.why: Takes categories from the existing getMonthFillCategories selection (which already applies the income/template/hidden rules) and the amount sign from the existing spendingToBudgetAmount helper, plus getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and mutator(undoable).

duplication.why: No rule is re-implemented; the action is just a selection call, a sheet read and a shared conversion.

placement.why: The action sits with the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with the same wrapping.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Short and built entirely on the shared month-fill definitions, so future rule changes reach it automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthFillCategories and spendingToBudgetAmount like set3MonthAvg.
